name: file-hero
title: File Hero
description: A design-components hero on a dashed blueprint grid. A fan of live UI cards flies out of a frosted glass folder, drifts with the cursor in depth, and lifts to the front on hover — each card works: play the video, flip the currency, add calories, reorder the starting grid, toggle stabilization, switch daily / weekly screen time, play the track, start the sprint timer. Side specimens (search, graph, calendar, transactions, bar chart, flight swap) are interactive too.
